text:
maya: Quick brain dump — proposing saved queries in Console analytics for per-route / per-model views. Want persisted filters, shareable queries, and a way to pin to dashboards. Thoughts?

jonp: Big yes. We need both UI + API. Key product asks: persist filters, set visibility (private/team/org), and ability to pin to a route or model page. Also support a preview run.

liam: Two technical constraints: (1) saved queries should be parameterized (time range, top-k, sample rate) rather than storing huge literal results, and (2) we need permissioning rules — team vs org visible. cc @sara

sara: UX note — customers use both model-scoped and route-scoped views. We should support a scope selector: Model / Route / Organization. Also allow cascading filters: if you pick model=X, route list filters to only routes using X.

alex: Telemetry question — do we run saved queries on raw logs or on rollups? Cost-wise we only have hourly rollups + 7d raw logs currently, so arbitrary long-range ad-hoc runs will be expensive. Need to show estimated cost before executing. :thinking_face: 

analytics-bot: job:query-cache-warm failed for window 1715800000-1715803600 — retry queued.

jonp: Proposed API shape (draft):
```
POST /saved-queries
{
  "name": "Errors by model - last 24h",
  "scope": "model", // model | route | org
  "scope_id": "redwood/gpt-7b-v2",
  "filters": { "status": ["error"], "latency_ms": {"gt": 200} },
  "params": { "time_range": "24h", "sample_rate": 0.1 },
  "visibility": "team" // private | team | org
}
```
We also need endpoints to preview results, export to dashboard, and list shared queries.

liam: Filter language concern — should we allow regex or only exact/tag matching + comparisons? Regex and wildcard are powerful but blow up compute. My vote: boolean expressions + exact/tag + numeric comparisons; defer regex to an opt-in job.

sara: From a product POV, saved queries should support quick toggles: "Apply to all models", "Link to current route", and a small changelog for edits. Versioning would be nice so teams don't accidentally change a shared query. :sparkles:

maya: Agree. One more: surface estimated token/record scan (i.e., cost) when previewing a saved query. We can reuse Redwood Optimize's cost estimates to warn users. Also consider TTL for cached previews.

alex: Implementation plan: prototype an API + minimal console panel showing saved queries, scopes, and preview cost. We'll add a feature flag to roll out internally first. Need to define cache TTL and expensive-query guardrails. I can put up a spike next week.

maya: Action items: alex -> prototype UI/API spike; liam -> draft filter grammar and limitations; jonp -> write API spec + example responses; sara -> mock a small UI flow and changelog. I'll create a ticket and tag the eng-platform and telemetry teams. :thumbsup:
